seriesTitle: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

episodes.title: Leo Nardo Stands Alone
episodes.summary: The Ninja Turtles are on the run and are alone; Leonardo is a leader who is without anyone to lead; Leo has to stop Bishop and her Mechazoids while trying to save his brothers.

episodes.title: Mikey Does The Right Thing
episodes.summary: To save his brothers, Mikey needs the help of Bishop's intern, Rod; but Rod wants something in return; he wants to be turned into a mutant.

episodes.title: Raphael Thinks it Through
episodes.summary: Raph's strength won't save him when he's caught between the Mechazoids and the notorious street gang known as Purple Dragons; Raph's going to have to use his head to get out.

episodes.title: Donnie Hangs Tough
episodes.summary: It's a battle of the wits between Donnie and Bishop as he races through NYC's subway system to stop her evil Mechazoids; discovering how do you beat an AI that counters every move.

episodes.title: Bishop Makes Her Move
episodes.summary: The origin of the woman called BISHOP! Why does she hate mutants? What is the secret of the Mechazoids? And exactly what happened the night the Turtles fell into Bishop's trap?

episodes.title: Night of the Mechazoids
episodes.summary: The Turtles take the fight to Bishop but she's ready for them; the Mechazoids go out of control.

episodes.title: Raph vs. Water
episodes.summary: The Turtles and Mutanimals are caught in the storm of the century; when a new group of sea mutants threaten the city, Raph will be forced to use his words to save the day.

episodes.title: Mikey Takes Charge
episodes.summary: Mikey and Genghis Frog are sent into the storm on a supply run to the local market when they encounter the electrifying Lee The Eeel; now Mikey has to step up and be a leader.

episodes.title: Splinter and April Fight a Goldfish
episodes.summary: When the Lair floods, April goes to save Splinter, but he won't leave the sewer; to make matters worse, the mutant called Goldfin comes with a warning of staying out of his way, or else.

episodes.title: Donnie Goes Deep
episodes.summary: Donnie and Wingnut go to restore power to the Lair but get trapped by the East River 3; the water is rising and they're not alone, there's a monster down there with them.

episodes.title: Leonardo Saddles Up
episodes.summary: The mutant seahorse called Mustang Sally is going to flood the city and the only thing standing in his way are Leo and Pigeon Pete; being the leader isn't all what it's cracked up to be.

episodes.title: The Pearl
episodes.summary: The East River 3 are on the verge on victory; The Turtles and Mutanimals must team up to stop them, but not everything is as it seems, they need to discover what is the pearl and why does Goldfin want it.

episodes.title: Mutant Battle Arena
episodes.summary: Raph's love for fighting puts him at odds with his brothers as they try and stop a rampaging Bebop and Rocksteady from wrecking the city.

episodes.title: Mutantweight Title Bout
episodes.summary: All Raph's dreams have come true as he fights against Rocksteady, Bebop and Mondo Gecko in the Mutant Battle Arena, not realizing it's a trap set by the Purple Dragons!

episodes.title: Raph Fights Everyone
episodes.summary: With his family under Kitsune's mind control, Raph no longer wants to fight but he's going to have to in order to save everybody he loves before it's too late.

episodes.title: The Island
episodes.summary: A mysterious new threat turns the Mutanimals against the Turtles, leading the boys to discover the source of this terrifying mutant... Staten Island

episodes.title: The Other Mutanimals
episodes.summary: Desperate to save Wingnut, Donnie delves deeper into the lab of a legit mad scientist...only for things to take a very monstrous turn.

episodes.title: The Rejects
episodes.summary: With his brothers captured by Tokka, Rahzar and the Monster Mutanimals, Donnie figures things can't get much worse. Enter: the Omega Mutant, the greatest monster to never win the Nobel Prize.

episodes.title: Rise of the Night Ninja
episodes.summary: An accidental heroic act launches Lea into full superhero-mode, but the Night Ninja may have met his match in the villainous LA FLEUR and her gang of... dognappers?

episodes.title: The Night Ninja Returns
episodes.summary: The villainous, dog-hating madman known as SCRATCH holds the city's dogs hostage! His only demand? For the Night Ninja to surrender! But Leo, April and the Turtles realize there's more to Scratch than meets the eye.

episodes.title: The Itching Scratch
episodes.summary: Leo's finally got his arch-enemy asthe Turtles take on Scratch and hismutant Vampire Fleas, a grudge-match fifteen years in the making!But what does it all have to do with Splinter? The final battle begins!!

episodes.title: Get Rod
episodes.summary: No one likes Rod, especially the Turtles! Bishop's former intern keeps trying to kidnap them and steam their mutant blood, but when Rod himself is kidnapped... Mikey is on the case! His first suspect: the mutant-hating Mechazoid maker BISHOP.

episodes.title: The Unusual Suspects
episodes.summary: With some loose Mutagen at stake, Mikey questions Rod's siblings, the notorious and eccentric MAUDE and TODD... bothof whom are trying to get their hands on some mutant blood as well. Can Mikey find Rod before it's too late?

episodes.title: The Big Muck
episodes.summary: Who kidnapped Rod? Where is the mutagen? Why is Rod's family so weird? All your questions are answered as Mikey and Rod confront Rod's dad... but even with the help of his brothers, can Mikey defeat the mutant known as MUCKMAN?
